description: Write the text for one of four requests, in en, ko, ja or zh: price_guarantee (claim to the booking site for the difference), date_change, goodwill_refund (for a non-refundable booking, with a reason) or checkin_request (upgrade, late check-out or breakfast, citing the lower price) to the hotel. Returns a short message for a chat or claim form and a full letter. The confirmation number and guest name are not accepted; they appear as placeholders in the text. With tracking_id, HotelRefund's recorded Agoda prices for the same dates are added to price_guarantee and checkin_request letters. The same letter can be saved as a PDF at refund_report_url.

booked_on.description: Booking site. Required for price_guarantee; omit for a direct hotel booking.

letter_language.description: Language of the text: en (default), ko, ja or zh. Usually the language the booking site or hotel reads.

lower_seen_at.description: When the lower price was seen, e.g. 2026-10-02 14:30.

new_check_in.description: date_change: requested new check-in, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to ask which dates are possible.

paid_total.description: Total paid, taxes included. Required for price_guarantee.

reason.description: goodwill_refund: why the stay cannot go ahead.

tracking_id.description: Optional HotelRefund tracking for the same stay.

name: draft_refund_request
title: Write a refund claim or hotel request
